verdict.rationale: Open WebUI keeps a Keep-a-Changelog changelog, commits to Semantic Versioning, and publishes per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases. That covers the versioned-releases, changelog, and part of the migration-notes elements of the story. The docs also warn that the :main tag can break without warning, and nothing in the pack documents a repair or rollback path after a failed update. Missing for 10: a documented rollback/downgrade or repair procedure, migration notes beyond the plugin API (e.g., database/config upgrades), and independent hands-on corroboration that updates are safe.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks
